field.label: Enabled
field.help: Show the sign-in button on the login page.

field.label: Button text
field.help: The text on the sign-in button.

field.label: Primary button
field.help: Draw the sign-in button in the theme's primary colour.

field.label: Hide password login
field.help: Hide the username and password form. The form is shown again when the login page is opened with ?local on its address; password login itself stays available.

field.label: Sign in automatically
field.help: Send the browser to the provider as soon as the login page opens. The page stays put after a refused or failed sign-in and when opened with ?local on its address.

field.label: Issuer
field.help: The provider's issuer URL. Its discovery document is read from /.well-known/openid-configuration below it.

field.label: Client ID
field.help: The client registered at the provider with the authorization code grant and the redirect URI https://this-firewall/oidc_callback.php.

field.label: Client secret
field.help: Sent to the token endpoint as client_secret_basic. Leave empty to keep the stored value.

field.label: Scopes
field.help: Space-separated scopes requested; openid is required.

field.label: Username claim
field.help: The claim whose value is looked up on the Users tab, read from the ID token or, when absent there, from the UserInfo endpoint. A value with no enabled entry, or an entry naming no enabled local user, is refused.

field.label: Prompt
field.help: What the provider asks at every sign-in.

field.label: Sign out at the provider
field.help: When a session started through the link ends on this firewall, revoke its token and end the session at the provider. The provider needs https://this-firewall/ as a post-logout redirect URI.
